title: Geologic Map of the St. Phillips Island Quadrangle, Beaufort County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2000, Geologic Map of the St. Phillips Island Quadrangle, Beaufort County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report 257, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Map sheet (page 1). Pages 2-4 are FGDC symbol-style notes that are not part of this map and were not recorded. Unit symbols are drawn in boxes beside the descriptions and are scattered in the text layer, so each symbol was read from the page image. Terrace groupings and their elevation ranges (Holocene terrace below 10 ft at its landward margin; Silver Bluff terrace above 6 ft seaward and below 10 ft landward; Princess Anne terrace above 12 ft seaward and below 18 ft landward) are in the descriptions. SCGS drill-hole labels on the map face (7-070 to 7-129) have no data or locations printed and were not recorded. Cross section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 200, sea-level datum, feet and meters axes): unit labels read from the image in order from A to A', no distances printed, so no contacts recorded. SUBSURFACE: section depicts units to about 30 ft below sea level; no unit tops or bases with values.
